rules.scope: remove a required-field obligation when all of its query-grounded evidence is weak token overlap wholly covered by typed operation evidence spans and the candidate has no independent explicit or semantic grounding
rules.rationale: Words such as mean, average, sum, and count denote analytical operations and must not independently ground schema fields that merely contain those tokens.
rules.failure_condition: The aggregation word average adds capital_average when the query explicitly requests capital_total.
rules.conflict_policy: Exact full-field, alias, value, acronym, or semantic grounding always preserves the field; candidates and raw evidence remain available for audit.
